notice: This export is a copy of local data for its owner. It transfers no permissions and is not an accepted audit record.

categories.label: Task history
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device
categories.deletion: Delete Task history in Local data (the runtime is stopped, the files are removed, then the runtime restarts)
categories.recovery: Reimport an earlier export into an empty runtime home; nothing else restores it

categories.label: Runtime logs
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: The runtime writes its log database while it runs, so a copy taken without stopping it is not consistent

categories.deletion: Delete Runtime logs in Local data (the runtime is stopped, the files are removed, then the runtime restarts)
categories.recovery: Not recoverable once deleted; the runtime starts a new log on its next start

categories.label: Runtime state and indexes
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Rebuildable: the runtime recreates its state, indexes and bundled files on start and rebuilds thread indexes from task history

categories.deletion: Delete Runtime state in Local data (the runtime is stopped, the files are removed, then the runtime restarts and recreates them)
categories.recovery: Rebuilt by the runtime on its next start

categories.label: Desktop runtime error log
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device
categories.deletion: Delete the Desktop runtime error log in Local data (the runtime is stopped so the log is closed, the file is removed, then the runtime restarts)
categories.recovery: Reimport an earlier export while no current log exists; otherwise not recoverable

categories.label: Identity session
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Holds Inquello session credentials, which are never exported

categories.deletion: Sign out, or delete the Identity session in Local data: it signs out through the shared service first (revocation attempted), then removes the file

categories.label: Device ID
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Identifies this installation; restoring it on another device would clone the installation identity

categories.deletion: Delete the Device ID in Local data; a new one is created at the next sign-in
categories.recovery: Not recoverable; a new device ID is created at the next sign-in

categories.label: Chromium profile
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Browser-engine caches and storage for the app's own pages; it holds no Task content and is recreated by the app

categories.deletion: Delete the Chromium profile in Local data: storage and caches are cleared through Electron, and files it holds open are recreated while the app runs
categories.recovery: Recreated by the app; nothing to restore

categories.label: Export journal
categories.owner: The signed-in creator, on this device

export.reason: Records this device's exports; each export carries its own manifest

categories.deletion: Delete the Export journal in Local data; exported copies are not deleted and leave Inquello's view once it is gone
categories.recovery: Not recoverable; exported copies keep their own manifests

categories.label: Provider credentials

export.reason: Provider credentials and secrets are never exported

categories.deletion: Not held: the desktop never writes it (Story 1.13 governs provider credentials)
